subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw remove `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` from the persisted config contract now, with doctor migration preserving the old no-export behavior, or keep the value until real gRPC exporter support exists?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but removing a shipped config value is a compatibility and product-contract choice that automation should not approve alone.

options.title: Accept strict config plus doctor migration
options.body: Merge this PR if maintainers agree that doctor-backed removal is the right compatibility path for unsupported gRPC configs.

options.title: Hold for real gRPC exporter support
options.body: Keep the config value and defer this PR if maintainers want the advertised `grpc` option to become a working exporter instead of being removed.

options.title: Revise migration semantics first
options.body: Ask for different doctor behavior if disabling enabled OTLP configs is not the desired upgrade outcome.

recommendation.title: Accept strict config plus doctor migration
recommendation.body: Merge this PR if maintainers agree that doctor-backed removal is the right compatibility path for unsupported gRPC configs.

likelyOwner.reason: The diagnostics OTel exporter/config surface dates to `steipete`'s commit `5c4079f66cc0`, making him the clearest history-backed owner for the config-contract decision.
